title: Wren and the Winter
author: Zephyrine Fairweather
blurb: Felix Underhill, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
